title: P8 real AIME GEPA readiness
description: Coordinate the remaining library and P8 work needed for AIME via Leaven to be genuinely durable, cached, resumable, source-auditable, and operator-ready. This epic tracks specs, implementation slices, worker handoffs, and final verification through P8.
acceptance_criteria: P8 uses durable-by-default Leaven run storage, GEPA continuation resume, target-safe case envelopes, SQLite-backed LM and eval caches, stable AIME source identity in reports, cache/cost/run-dir summaries, and focused tests plus final readiness verification.

title: Implement case visibility and target isolation
description: Hard-cut leaven-run away from raw case payloads: runners see only candidate plus case id/input, scorers can see target through a target-aware context, metadata is projected intentionally, and reports preserve case ids without leaking hidden targets. Primary spec: docs/specs/case_visibility_and_target_isolation.md. Active worker: Socrates.
acceptance_criteria: Runner type signature cannot access target or metadata; scorer receives optional target; input-only cases still work; tests prove runner target isolation and scorer target access.
closed_reason: Socrates implemented target-isolated case envelopes for ordinary leaven-run paths. Focused checks passed: cargo check -p leaven-eval -p leaven-run; cargo nextest run -p leaven-run --test scoring_evaluator --test optimize_builder; cargo nextest run -p leaven-eval; cargo test -p leaven --test topology_contract; cargo test -p leaven --test public_surface_contract. Remaining scaffold is tracked in follow-on P8/cache/report work.

title: Implement SQLite eval cache backend after compatibility
description: Follow-on after leaven-env.3/leaven-env.4: add a durable SQLite-backed engine evaluation cache table/store once evaluator/case/runtime compatibility keys are stable. This is intentionally separated from the first eval-cache product integration slice, which uses existing checkpointed cache state.
acceptance_criteria: SQLite eval cache persists across reopen with schema/version checks, preserves EvaluationCacheKey semantics, records hit/miss/bypass/write errors, charges zero cost on hits, and has corrupt-store typed failures.

title: Add durable SQLite LM response cache
description: Implement SQLite-backed LmCacheStore for durable run-dir LM response caching. Primary spec: docs/specs/default_cache_storage.md plus docs/specs/lm_runtime_and_response_cache.md. Active worker: Laplace.
acceptance_criteria: SQLite LM cache persists entries across reopen, preserves cache key law, works with CachedLm policies, leaves InMemoryLmCache for tests/ephemeral, and passes leaven-lm-cache tests.
closed_reason: Completed by Laplace: SqliteLmCache implemented/exported/tested; leaven-lm-cache nextest, topology, and clippy passed; leaven-run integration intentionally left for later CacheMode/Auto slice.

title: Spec and implement engine eval cache product integration
description: Primary spec is docs/specs/default_cache_storage.md. Explorer plan: implement smallest safe product integration first by surfacing existing checkpointed engine EvaluationCache summary and proving deterministic engine evaluators avoid repeated work across run_dir resume. Do not make ScoringEvaluator deterministic or add SQLite eval-cache until leaven-env.4 provides runner/scorer/case compatibility fingerprints. SQLite eval-cache remains follow-on once key/schema compatibility is stable.
acceptance_criteria: Spec identifies cache key/fingerprint responsibilities and product defaults; implementation exposes automatic safe eval caching for deterministic scorer/evaluator paths, restores cache across run_dir resume, reports hit/miss/bypass, and proves zero repeated metric calls.

title: Spec and implement resume compatibility fingerprints
description: Primary spec written at docs/specs/resume_compatibility_fingerprints.md. Implement the manifest/refusal layer for durable resume: case input/target/split identities, runner/scorer/evaluator fingerprints, optimizer compatibility linkage, LM role fingerprints, cache/budget compatibility, and typed mismatch errors before any costful work.
acceptance_criteria: Resume validates runner/scorer/evaluator/case shape compatibility before running; errors are typed and explain mismatch; tests prove incompatible scorer/runtime/case changes refuse.

title: Spec and implement AIME case source/report adapter
description: Primary spec written at docs/specs/aime_case_report_adapter.md. Implement the P8 AIME adapter by lowering import records into Case<AimeInput, AimeTarget>, deriving stable source-based CaseIds, preserving source/report metadata without runner visibility, projecting report source ids, and wiring compatibility/cache identities.
acceptance_criteria: Spec names AIME input/target/metadata/report fields and visibility rules; implementation produces stable case ids and report source ids; tests prove runner gets input only, scorer gets answer target, and reports preserve source provenance.

title: Spec and implement P8 reflection/evidence visibility
description: Primary spec written at docs/specs/gepa_reflection_evidence_visibility.md. Implement target-safe GEPA reflection projection for P8: reflection sees runner input, generated output, scores, scorer feedback, and provenance refs; it must not read raw targets/full metadata/hidden validation or test cases except through explicit policy.
acceptance_criteria: Spec defines reflection visibility and storage; implementation prevents reflection from reading hidden targets except through scorer-produced evidence; tests prove reflection receives feedback/evidence summaries and not raw target envelopes.

title: Spec and implement P8 run report and operator UX
description: Define and implement the ordinary P8 run output surface: run dir, resumability, cache summaries, budget/metric-call summary, train/validation/test scores, source-id summaries, best candidate, stop reason, and clear non-benchmark versus product-proof language.
acceptance_criteria: Spec and result facade/report expose required operator fields; durable report is written under the run dir; tests or example proof verify summary fields without leaking hidden answers.

title: Spec and implement P8 live-provider budget reliability
description: Define and implement P8 live-provider execution constraints: metric-call cap, LM cost accounting, retry/idempotency boundaries, cache hit charging, stop-at-budget semantics, and provider/runtime fingerprint reporting.
acceptance_criteria: Spec states provider/budget semantics; implementation records provider/LM cost and metric-call caps durably; tests prove budget stop is resumable and cache hits do not double-charge.

title: Run P8 AIME integration proof
description: Assemble the final P8 proof after durability, cache, compatibility, AIME adapter, reflection visibility, report UX, and provider budget slices land. This is the readiness gate, not a substitute for missing lower-level specs.
acceptance_criteria: A focused P8 AIME run uses durable defaults, SQLite LM/eval caches where eligible, GEPA resume continuation, target-safe cases, stable source reporting, provider/budget accounting, and resume without repeated committed evaluations. Final verification includes focused tests plus the appropriate milestone command; just check before product maturity claim.
